column1: # Every branch this fork has ever deleted, and the proof that allowed it.
# A branch may be deleted only if it is PROVABLY MERGED: GitHub reports the PR
# MERGED *and* at least one mechanical proof passes --
#   B  git cherry upstream/develop origin/$b | grep -c "^+"   (0 => absorbed)
# B is the one that catches a squash-merge. If GitHub says MERGED and both
# proofs fail, the branch is NOT prunable. See "Branch retention" in
# FORK_RULES.md for the full rule, the archive ref, and the approval step.
# Append one row per deletion, AFTER refs/fork/archive/<branch> is pushed and
# BEFORE the branch is removed. Never edit or remove a row -- this file is the
# only record that survives a fresh clone. Recover with:
